limitations: Phonological-rule errors are not observable: the acoustic output passes the same G2P as the target, so e.g. missing tensification in 춥고도 cannot be detected.
heard_errors run the same classifier on Whisper for display; they are not scored.
Explanations are fixed templates keyed by tag (src/labels.py); no LLM is involved.
